oil.when: 2025 Sorento Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid (Service mode in the instrument cluster)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the scheduled service has been done).
Switch the vehicle on and bring up the Service mode screen in the instrument cluster display.
Press and hold the OK button for more than 1 second. The countdown restarts at the miles and days that were set before.
Switch off and on again and check that the Service interval or Service required message no longer appears.
oil.note: Checked in the 2025 Sorento Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid owner's manual. The countdown can be wrong after the battery has been disconnected or run flat.

tpms.when: 2025 Sorento Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid (no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label on the driver's door pillar, checking them before driving or after the car has sat a few hours.
There is no reset button or menu for the tire pressure light. Once every tire is at or slightly above the recommended pressure, the light turns off by itself.
If the light stays on, recheck each tire with an accurate gauge. Air-station gauges can read off, so the tire may still be a little under the label pressure.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2025 Sorento Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid owner's manual. If the tire pressure light blinks for about a minute at startup and then stays on, the monitoring system has a fault; setting the pressures will not clear it, so have it checked. Cold weather lowers tire pressure and can turn the light on even if the tires were set correctly in warm weather.
